scope: Prepare a five-unit restricted GNSS prototype candidate for supplier stock, DFM and assembly-preview review; ordering approval will be given later.
gnss_front_end: MAX-M10S integrated receiver front end with passive antenna; no external SAW filter is populated
experiment_controls: Initial GNSS baseline with modem physically unpowered and LTE/BLE transmission disabled.
Verify the modem rail is off; do not infer no-transmit from a post-boot firmware command.
Before modem power-up, use a separately reviewed RF configuration for controlled coexistence measurements.
Routine simultaneous LTE/GNSS operation is not approved by this experiment acceptance.
supplier_upload_scope: JLCPCB stock availability, DFM and assembly-preview review only
